title.narrative: Strengthening government capacity on Strategic Communication and Information Resilience in the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: Contract related to: Strengthening government capacity on Strategic Communication and Information Resilience in the Republic of Moldova - This 18-months exceptional assistance measure aims to strengthen Moldova¿s resilience in a heightened hybrid threat environment. A first component will focus on further strengthening the cyber resilience of the Republic of Moldova. This component will provide support to ensure that the ground is prepared for the new Cybersecurity Law to enter into force in 2025 as planned. This will include support to the establishment of the national competent authority on cyber security. A second component will provide support to building a more resilient information space in Moldova. This will include supporting a limited number of independent media outlets and civil society organisations to ensure the continued provision of high-quality, independently researched information, as well as assisting the Audio-Visual Council of Moldova as the monitoring body for audio-visual media. A third component will focus on support to the establishment of the new strategic communications centre of Moldova, including facilitating the inclusive development and implementation of a strategy and work plan.

Working visit of the Analysts Team of the Moldovan Centre of Strategic Communication and Countering Disinformation to Estonia 1718 June 2024.9.
